Source: https://sapling.ai/ai-content-detector
Accessed: 2026-08-15
Archive: https://web.archive.org/web/20260815125206/https://sapling.ai/ai-content-detector

Page purpose statement (establishes OUTPUT TYPE for domain-11 rights variables):
"This free AI detector outputs the probability that a text is AI-generated by a model
such as ChatGPT or Gemini. Detect AI slop and machine-generated content. Helpful for
educators, SEO practitioners, and reviewers of user-generated content."

Live tool output observed on page load (no sign-in performed, no account created):
"Fake: 73.6%" (a percentage score)
"Share Certificate (Expires after 3 Days)" with a "Copy" link (not clicked/activated --
clicking it would create a shareable artifact/link, which is a use-the-product action
outside the documents-only scope, so it was left un-clicked; the label itself is still
documentary evidence that any share artifact is a time-limited (3-day) reference/receipt,
not a persistent, standalone media deliverable).
"Show Sentence Perplexity Scores" (per-sentence numeric breakdown)

This confirms the product's principal output is a probability score / per-sentence
prediction report, not an image, video, audio file, or generated text deliverable --
i.e. not a "media artifact" in the codebook's sense used for watermark_removal_tier's
own worked example ("a detection score or an analysis table").

Free-tier limit FAQ (the free version's only documented cap):
Q: "My text is getting cut off. How can I run the AI detector on longer texts?"
A: "The free version is currently truncated to 2000 characters (roughly 400 to 500
tokens). Pro and Enterprise Sapling subscribers can paste texts of up to 100,000
characters (roughly 20,000 to 25,000 tokens). For texts longer than that, please break
up the text into multiple sections, or consider using our API. If you plan to process
more than 5 million characters/month, contact us to see how we can better support your
use case."

This is the ONLY quantified limit documented for the free tool (input length, a standing
cap -- "2000 characters"). No monthly/daily count cap on number of checks is documented
anywhere on this page.

Accuracy / methodology text (context only, not coded):
"Type or paste text above to score. The AI detector becomes much more accurate after 50
or so words."
"2025-01-20 Increased context length to 100,000 characters." (changelog entry --
consistent with the Pro/Enterprise 100,000-character figure above)
